units.source_text: 我们的恋爱是在胚胎学的研究室里萌生的。

en.t: Our love began to grow in an embryology laboratory.

units.source_text: 你似乎认为胚胎学这门科学拥有惊人的力量，

en.t: You seem to believe that the science of embryology possesses an astonishing power,

units.source_text: 它是无法用诸如神灵的创造力或恶魔的破坏力这类语言来表现的。

en.t: one that cannot be expressed in terms like the creative power of gods or the destructive power of demons.

units.source_text: 缘此，你爱上了身为胚胎学者的我。

en.t: Because of that, you fell in love with me as an embryologist.

units.source_text: 然而，这种爱其实是一种憎哟。

en.t: And yet, that love is actually a kind of hatred.

units.source_text: 如今的我就是这样认为的。

en.t: That is what I believe now.

units.source_text: 这就是说，你憎恨胚胎学的理想，

en.t: In other words, you hate the ideals of embryology,

units.source_text: 你把女人中的母亲和胚胎学搅到一块。

en.t: and you mix up the mother within womanhood with embryology.

units.source_text: 就说现在吧，真正想要孩子的人，不是我而是你啊！

en.t: Take the present moment: the one who truly wants a child is not me, but you!

units.source_text: 你急欲将这个事实颠倒过来，这正好嘛，

en.t: You are desperate to turn that fact upside down, and that is just right,

units.source_text: 你正逐渐站在胚胎学者的立场上看问题，

en.t: because you are gradually coming to see things from the position of an embryologist,

units.source_text: 我正逐渐学会从母亲的角度看问题。

en.t: while I am gradually learning to see things from a mother's point of view.
That is what marriage is, I suppose.

units.source_text: 让我们首先把夫妻关系搞得如胶似蜜，不好吗？”

en.t: So shall we first make our relationship as husband and wife close and inseparable?
